from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional

app = FastAPI()
items = {1: {"id": 1, "name": "apple", "price": 1.0}}

class ItemPatch(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = None
    price: Optional[float] = None

@app.patch("/items/{item_id}")
def patch_item(item_id: int, patch: ItemPatch):
    if item_id not in items:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found")
    stored = items[item_id]
    update = patch.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    stored.update(update)
    return stored

---END---

---FILE: main.py---
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from jose import jwt

app = FastAPI()
SECRET = "change-me"
ALGO = "HS256"
pwd = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")
_users = {"alice": pwd.hash("wonderland")}

class LoginIn(BaseModel):
    username: str
    password: str

@app.post("/login")
def login(data: LoginIn):
    hashed = _users.get(data.username)
    if not hashed or not pwd.verify(data.password, hashed):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="bad credentials")
    token = jwt.encode({"sub": data.username}, SECRET, algorithm=ALGO)
    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer"}

---END---
